relations.subject: Tsoknyi Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Tsoknyi Rinpoche (Wylie tshogs gnyis rin po che) or Ngawang Tsoknyi Gyatso (born 13 March 1966) is a Tibetan Buddhist teacher and author, and the founder of the Pundarika Foundation.

relations.subject: Tsoknyi Rinpoche
relations.place: Tashi Jong in Himachal Pradesh, India
relations.evidence: At the age of thirteen, he began his education at Khampagar Monastery at Tashi Jong in Himachal Pradesh, India.

relations.subject: Tsoknyi Rinpoche
relations.evidence: His main teachers are Khamtrul Rinpoche Dongyu Nyima, his father Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Nyoshul Khen Rinpoche and Adeu Rinpoche.
